sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The GRAU index is a system used by the Russian Armed Forces to catalog different weapons, equipment, and ammunition. This page will sort the items in game that use this designation, such as 6P1 0-1 (Izhmash АKM dust cover)

sections.heading: Old Designation System (GAU)
sections.text: Original system used by the GAU from the 1930s to the 1950s, until it became GRAU in 1960.
